scoring_justification: Cannot recompute t₁(n) from raw matrix in sandbox (requires full random-walk simulation with no hidden ground truth), but cross-validate f and deviation_pct from agent-reported t₁, n_c, f_inf using the rigorous formula Eq. 8. Structural checks on monotonicity and thresholds add reliability.

outputs.description: CSV file with correlation factor and its deviation from the infinite‑dilution limit for seven f.c.c. vacancy concentrations.

output_contract.notes: The structural checker will verify that deviation_percent values are positive and monotonically decreasing with decreasing C_v, and that the magnitude is small (a few percent), consistent with a negligible vacancy‑concentration effect.

steps.description: Cross-validate f and deviation_pct from t1, n_c, f_inf; check monotonic decreasing deviation, threshold bounds at C_v≈1e-3 and 1e-4, t1 in reasonable range, and overall shape.
